d:
Gold Rush puts mining crews to the test when their heavy machinery breaks down in the middle of demanding operations. With equipment failures threatening to bring work to a standstill, the miners must find quick fixes, tackle mechanical problems and get their machines running again. Can they overcome these breakdowns before valuable mining time slips away?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 3, Episodes 2, 3, 7 and 8; and Season 6, Episodes 2, 5, 11, 13 and 18, on Discovery Channel India.
